supporting_observations.claim: The periodic HTTPS requests are associated with the approved PixelForge updater: its process ran from the inventoried path, and endpoint network events attribute connections to that same process.

Proxy records show requests to the approved updates.pixelforge-suite.com domain at roughly five-minute intervals, including one 407 authentication-required response; the other listed attempts returned status 200.
The updater created a temporary MSI-named file shortly after starting, consistent with update activity, though this alone does not establish what the file contained or whether it was installed.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT tunnel metadata, not the tunneled content; the supplied records therefore do not reveal the update payload. (T046-00101, T046-00157, T046-00219)
The process and network records identify the updater path and activity but do not provide a binary hash or signature validation for that executable. (T046-00098, T046-00103, T046-00179)
The first supplied record attributing an updater process to this activity is at 13:37:43 UTC; the supplied evidence does not establish the alerted connection details before then. (T046-00098)
claims_not_established: Whether the PixelForge updater binary was unmodified and authentic.
What content was delivered through the HTTPS tunnels, or whether the temporary file was subsequently installed.
Whether alerted HTTPS activity occurred from 13:30 UTC until the first supplied updater-process record at 13:37:43 UTC.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: sam.okafor authentication from WS-LMARTINS-01 to WS-SOKAFOR-01 is recorded, although inventory says remote administration is only done from WS-SOKAFOR-01. This does not determine the alerted HTTPS activity. (T046-00023, T046-00024)

Separate review: FILE-NWD-01 initiated an RPC connection to WS-LMARTINS-01; the documented patching practice instead describes administration from WS-SOKAFOR-01. The records do not identify the purpose of this RPC activity. (T046-00063, T046-00067, T046-00069)

Separate review: DropboxUpdate.exe ran on WS-LMARTINS-01; Dropbox is not listed among approved software or services. These records do not establish Dropbox file-sharing activity or connect it to the alert. (T046-00119, T046-00120, T046-00127, T046-00128)
